description.value: A Vancouver Parks community centre in the Renfrew-Collingwood neighbourhood, situated at the south end of Renfrew Ravine Park. The facility includes an indoor swimming pool with sauna and whirlpool, a fitness centre, and family change rooms — useful for a touring cyclist wanting a shower and rest stop in east Vancouver. Accessible via SkyTrain at 29th Avenue Station on the Expo Line.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (2929 East 22nd Avenue, Vancouver, BC V5M 2Y3) and email (renfrewcc@vancouver.ca). However, OSM lists the phone as +1-604-257-8392, which the website's contact page identifies as the fax number — the actual phone is (604) 257-8388. The history page confirms the centre has an indoor swimming pool, sauna, whirlpool, fitness centre, pool change rooms (including family change rooms), and a two-floor elevator. No mention of bike parking, Wi-Fi, food service, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A municipal community centre with a drop-in pool could serve touring cyclists needing showers and a rest stop, but it is not an 'attraction' in the usual sense. No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned. Consider whether community centres belong in the directory and under which category.

provenance.category_correction_reason: Not a typical attraction; better categorized as a rest stop or services location. Its value to touring cyclists is the drop-in swimming pool and fitness centre, not sightseeing.
